AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Traffic Safety Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Committee meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to AB 361 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's recommended measures to promote social distancing. All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed; however, the meeting will be recorded and made available on the City's website. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81995765950
Zoom Meeting ID: 819 9576 5950
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 819 9576 5950#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Please submit your correspondence in writing to ccowley@pvestates.org. Comments received by NOON on Wednesday, May 4, 2022 will be forwarded to the Committee Members and posted online as late correspondence. All correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to participate under COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC or on any item of interest on the Agenda by simply utilizing the "Raise Hand" feature during the item under consideration. When called upon to speak please state your name for the record. All speakers will receive 3 minutes to speak during public comment or on the item indicated. Members of the public are not required to submit notification in advance. If you wish to show any visual aids while you speak during the meeting, you may submit a PDF version (maximum 20 slides) no later than 12:00 PM (Noon) on Wednesday, May 4, 2022 to aseims@pvestates.org.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under Traffic Safety Committee Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.
